notes.title: Update 2 Released
notes.content:
I've fixed the strangeness with the level changes, there was a bug in the custom collisions with the asteroid fields. I'm still not 100% sure if it is a problem with the custom collisions in general (which would surprise me as the player uses them as well), or if there is a particular 'bad' one. For now I've rolled them back to rectangular collisions. 

There may be some areas which throw some false positives on a suit breach. I tried to fix as many as I could find that would defiantly throw it. If you find one, shoot me the level number and I'll get it fixed right away.

I'm also going to do some more due diligence on the custom collision issue.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update 2 Coming
notes.content:
A few players reported an issue occurring when changing levels from 2-4 to 2-5, 2-5 to 2-6, 2-6 to 2-7, 2-7 to 2-8, 2-9 to 2-10.

The problem does not manifest itself when previewing the game, only when it's compiled and packaged. Very strange.

I'm 99% sure I've tracked down the problem, the custom collision shapes on the asteroid fields. If I remove them it functions normally. Testing out a fix now.

In the meantime, if the screen does get stuck white, if you quit the game and reenter, you can hit the play button to pick up where you left off.

Happy Memorial Day!
